findings: F2 not confirmed: result_gateway.py:1785-1790 observes a valid stopped rejected/negative-review result before rejection. MissionReservation.fail at agent_contract_runner.py:1611-1622 saves rejected/observed plus mission blocked in the same state replacement, before result_gateway.py:1883-1885 attempts the rejection receipt. Thus the review's alleged gap before a separate legacy block_loop_state_after_dispatch_failure call does not authorize dispatch. Same intent is closed; new intent hits mission_work_timeout's blocked-state guard. Missing rejected receipt remains a conservative blocked outcome. Product resume reports awaiting_review with replayAllowed=false; it does not create a passing receipt.

F3 not confirmed: atomic_write_loop_state at agent_contract_runner.py:982-1001 fsyncs the file, replaces it, and fsyncs its directory; exceptions propagate. reserve_mission_dispatch at :1754-1766 persists counters/intent before returning launch authority and releases the lock on failure. before_spawn saves the dispatch barrier before Popen. MissionReservation.save at :1499-1520 marks the object unusable, preserves spent counters, attempts a conservative unknown-effect state, and re-raises on OSError. Persistent write failure leaves the prior reserved/running/captured state, which blocks new product dispatch rather than refunding its reservation or replaying the child.

remainingRisks: Proof uses real local child processes running deterministic fake native CLIs and injected syscall errors. No actual Codex/Claude model invocation, live Hermes installation/deployment, physical power loss, disk corruption or kernel SIGKILL-at-write-boundary campaign was performed. Successful filesystem syscalls/fsync are assumed to honor their documented semantics; silent storage rollback is not established.

On rejection-receipt interruption, rejected/observed state and blocked mission remain durable, but controller-acceptance.json can be absent. Restart is conservatively blocked; this task does not add automated receipt reconstruction.

F3 deliberately permits unknown_effect after ambiguous persistence. This is a closed reconciliation state, not acceptance or replay authority. Persistent pre-replace acceptance-write failure can leave a complete captured candidate that later finishes acceptance from saved proof without rerunning product.
